interactive_guard.scope: Native normal demo, no report or capture hooks, async health scans enabled, default audience view, no host owner ceiling. Expected nonzero error exit after observed loss; no mode fallback. This does not guarantee no earlier frame lost fragments.

storage_lower_bound.scope: Derived from the fixed 4-node/pixel full-target configuration and observed global loss. Ignores other GPU allocations/driver overhead; not VRAM residency. Filling the remaining 128 MiB policy budget cannot hold this near-view demand.

source_scope: Initial near pair uses the first host-opt-in/control binary; later orbit/low4 runs use the health-guard/report-verdict binary; low8/ordinary-low runs use the explicit-reservation binary. Report runs explicitly retain failures and bypass interactive stop-on-loss. Renderer, simulation and art inputs are unchanged across versions; snapshots preserve all versions.
limits: A completed diagnostic is not acceptance. Global loss cannot be repaired by sorting accepted lists. No count, light, density, resolution or memory-ceiling reduction/increase is hidden in these comparisons. Shared mode stays experimental and interactive mode stops after asynchronous loss detection; report cost/profile lanes omit health scans and cannot certify capture capacity.
